workaround_steps: Playback streams successfully at Standard Definition (SD/480p) resolution under Widevine L3 software CDM.
If black screen occurs during video playback, disable hardware accelerated decoding inside Prime Video application settings.
On Standard Edition (Magisk), enable Magisk DenyList for Prime Video to prevent DRM initialization errors.
known_issues: Widevine L1 hardware security is not present in Windows Subsystem for Android; maximum streaming resolution is capped at 480p SD.
